records.name: Ars Nova Workshop
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that presents new jazz and improvised music at Solar Myth, a listening room and cafe. It has concerts scheduled through December 2026 and offers memberships and volunteer help.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a concert at Solar Myth, join as a member for ticket discounts and members-only events, or sign up for the volunteer pool to help with mailings and special events.

schedule.text: Concerts at 8 pm unless noted, from October through December 2026, including October 23, October 24, and November 19 to 21. Check the events list for the latest dates.

locations.label: Solar Myth (listening room and cafe, in the former Boot & Saddle space)

cost.text: Concert tickets vary by show. Memberships are $10, $20, $40, or $150 a month, by tier.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to a Solar Myth concert, or sign up through the short form on the volunteer page to be added to the volunteer pool.
first_step.basis: Concerts are on sale to anyone, and the volunteer sign-up is a short public form.

records.notes: The news section is stale: its newest article is from March 2025, though the event listings run to December 2026. The Coltrane 100 program dated September 1, 2026 is the newest dated homepage item. No address or phone is published on the site. Batch address 1901 S 9th St Ste 509 is not used. No exact interest tag fits a jazz concert series, so interests are left empty. Membership tiers, per the membership page: Mars $10, Venus $20, Jupiter $40, Saturn $150 a month.
